_doc: Lesson-B Teacher tuning (Project LESSON-B spec, sections 8 and 17.4). Speeds are in spec units (1 tile = 10 u); the game scales them to its own map.
_pacing: Anger still follows the spec formulas, but its effect is bounded so the ramp is smooth: avgSpeed and wait are limited to what anger = 2 would give at each notebook count. Remove these two arrays to get the raw spec behaviour.
